description: We are a team of students from El Calafate, in southern Argentina, driven by the idea of developing a tool that could help revolutionize the future of space exploration.
summary:
The human body undergoes multiple changes during space missions. Changes in gravity and exposure to space radiation can cause serious physical and psychological health problems. That is why we created A.E.T.H.E.R (Autonomous Environment & Telemetry Health Evaluation Rig).
Using data collected through an Oura Ring, A.E.T.H.E.R gathers, processes and present health information in a simple and accesible way, allowing astronauts and mission teams to easily understand and monitor the astronaut's overall health.
projectRefs: Why Do We Conduct Science Experiments in Space? (CSA)
